sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for IRM; mixed congressional activity (1 purchase vs 2 sales, all small amounts, 182+ days old), neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (255.5) indicates extreme market stress, and real estate sector faces structural headwinds in high-rate environment; earnings in 94 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Technical setup shows three bullish crossovers (stoch, MACD, three white soldiers) with price near support (45.65), offering a defined risk entry if macro conditions stabilize.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, real estate sector headwinds), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional conviction, high earnings risk in 94 days), and technical conviction is undermined by weak ADX, overbought stoch, below-average volume, and price below TEMA.
